scope: Independent vector wrench reconstruction for foundation feet and rails; nominal bolt-group recovery; mechanism stop statics and pin section arithmetic. No finite-element, contact, weld, material or physical validation.
resolved_findings: Initial mechanism handoff used old longitudinal bolt spacing. Author withdrew duplicate bolt results and made the foundation file canonical; final integrated CAD synchronization remains to be checked.
Initial foundation verification claimed rail equilibrium without assertions. Author added explicit all-force/three-moment/rail assertions; independent vector reconstruction performed here.
Initial foundation centerline-only loading omitted transverse occupancy sensitivity. Author added occupantCG offset plus front/back comparison offsets; revised demand envelope is higher.

Initial stop screen used only the contact-land centroid. Author added near-edge resultant sensitivity and shifted the land to localX1.0..1.5in with nominal1.25in arm; CAD reconciliation remains necessary.
limitations: Linear tributary load shares and roll partitions are sensitivity assumptions, not solved connection or frame stiffness. Cases do not establish a universal worst distribution.
The plate prying multipliers are unverified sensitivity factors. Gross-strip stresses below material yield do not mean joint acceptance or define allowable passenger loads.

Nominal stoparm1.25in assumes a contact resultant. Near-edge contact at1.0in raises reaction; the full land cannot simultaneously be assumed uniformly loaded in that edge-contact case. Actual contact stress remains unresolved.
Pin calculations are nominal center-force beam/average double-shear screens; notch, fits, retainer, edge effects, contact, fatigue and wear are excluded.
Post/rail/member gross screens omit local attachment, weld and wall resistance; final CAD dimensions and masses must be reconciled before reuse.
Wheelchair clearances, actual device maneuvering, companion alignment, guards and mechanism sweep are separate geometry and human-factors reviews.
